name: EM FX Performance: Fed Hiking vs Cutting Cycles
description: Research study analyzing BRL, MXN, and ZAR performance during Fed hiking cycles vs cutting cycles since 2000. Uses the Fed Funds Rate to identify regime changes (rate increase = hiking, rate decrease = cutting) and holds the regime until the direction reverses. FX pairs are inverted (1/USDXXX) so local currency appreciation = positive return. Per-asset line chart shows cumulative EM currency return with shaded background bands for hiking (orange) vs cutting (blue) regimes. Cross-sectional summary table shows total return during each regime and days spent in each regime per currency.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM FX PERFORMANCE: FED HIKING VS CUTTING CYCLES
# =============================================================================
# Currencies: BRL, MXN, ZAR (inverted from USD/XXX so appreciation = positive)
# Regimes: Fed hiking cycle (rate rising) vs cutting cycle (rate falling)
# Chart: Cumulative return per currency with shaded regime bands
# Table: Total return & days in each regime per currency
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# FED FUNDS DATA & REGIME CLASSIFICATION
# =============================================================================

fed_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
fed_value = fed_data.result
had_fed = is_valid(fed_value)

# Prior Fed Funds reading (the one before current)
prior_fed = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_fed, fed_value)
fed_change = fed_value - prior_fed

# Regime events: any rate increase starts hiking, any decrease starts cutting
is_hike_event = had_fed and is_valid(fed_change) and (fed_change > 0.0)
is_cut_event = had_fed and is_valid(fed_change) and (fed_change < 0.0)

# Persistent regimes via hold_until
is_hiking = hold_until()(enter=is_hike_event, exit=is_cut_event)
is_cutting = hold_until()(enter=is_cut_event, exit=is_hike_event)

# Regime band signals (1 = active, 0 = inactive) for shaded backgrounds
hiking_band = 1.0 if is_hiking else 0.0
cutting_band = 1.0 if is_cutting else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# INVERTED FX RETURNS (local currency appreciation = positive)
# =============================================================================
# market_data_source gives USD/XXX; invert to XXX/USD
inv_close = 1.0 / close
daily_ret = (inv_close - (inv_close >> 1)) / (inv_close >> 1)

# Clean daily return (NaN guard)
daily_ret_clean = daily_ret if is_valid(daily_ret) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE RETURNS (total, hiking-only, cutting-only)
# =============================================================================

cum_total = cumulative()(daily_ret_clean)

# Regime-filtered returns
hiking_ret = daily_ret_clean if is_hiking else 0.0
cutting_ret = daily_ret_clean if is_cutting else 0.0

cum_hiking = cumulative()(hiking_ret)
cum_cutting = cumulative()(cutting_ret)

# =============================================================================
# REGIME DAY COUNTS
# =============================================================================

hiking_day = 1.0 if is_hiking else 0.0
cutting_day = 1.0 if is_cutting else 0.0
hiking_day_clean = hiking_day if is_valid(hiking_day) else 0.0
cutting_day_clean = cutting_day if is_valid(cutting_day) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Chart: Cumulative Return with Regime Bands (per asset) ---
xy_lines(
    title='EM Currency Cumulative Return with Fed Regime Overlay',
    category='Fed Cycle Impact',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Return', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hiking Cum. Return', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cutting Cum. Return', color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hiking Cycle', color=Color.Orange, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cutting Cycle', color=Color.Teal, is_band=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=bar_idx, y_values=(cum_total, cum_hiking, cum_cutting, hiking_band, cutting_band))

# --- Cross-Sectional Summary Table ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Regime Performance Summary',
    category='Fed Cycle Impact',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Regime Performance Summary',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Hiking Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cutting Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hiking Days', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cutting Days', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    order=1
)(cum_hiking, cum_cutting, cumulative()(hiking_day_clean), cumulative()(cutting_day_clean))
